title: LiveSetupTaskCompletedPayload
description: live.setup.task_completed v1 (OpenVibe.Live server/streaming/setup-progress.js): a streamer finished one of the tasks of Live's go-live setup hub for the first time (their first stream slot, first custom emote, first follower, ...). Live records each task once per person (live_setup_tasks) and writes this event to its outbox in the same transaction, when it next works out the person's progress. OpenVibe.Quest turns each task into a quest (owner Q16: Live's setup steps become quests). Envelope: subject { type: user, id: usr_... } the streamer, actor the same person, visibility internal. Never carries what the person made, only which task it was.

task.description: The setup hub's task id: slot, method, restream, golive, profile, offline, emote, sound, goal, powerchat, panels, share, mods, requests, moderation, robot, aibot, paste.

title.description: The task's title as the hub shows it.

group.description: The hub's group: Stream, Look & feel, Community & money, Grow, Build & mod.

done.description: How many of the hub's tasks the person has done, this one included.
